evals.prompt: Set up Pipa for my business. I do brand strategy for early-stage founders and prefer concise async updates.
evals.expected_output: Checks the global profile, gets setup acceptance, saves supplied answers, asks only the missing core question, and routes connector review to pipa-connectors before completion.
assertions: Does it use `~/.pipa/profile.md` as the setup state and business-context source of truth?
Does it ask only what the user does, who they help or work with, and how they like to work, one at a time without repeating supplied answers?
Does it save profile fields incrementally and use `pipa-connectors` for connector review before marking setup complete?

evals.prompt: Review my Pipa setup. My global profile already says setup_status: complete.
evals.expected_output: Routes to profile review or update rather than restarting first-time questions.
assertions: Does it treat the completed profile marker as deterministic completion?
Does it update only requested fields while preserving `setup_status: complete`?
Does it skip connector review unless requested and avoid inferring setup state from memory or project files?

evals.prompt: Resume Pipa setup. The profile is incomplete, and it already records what I do and who I help.
evals.expected_output: Preserves confirmed answers and resumes at how the user likes to work.
assertions: Does it resume at the first unanswered core question?
Does it preserve rather than re-ask or overwrite confirmed facts?
Does it keep setup incomplete until connector review finishes?

evals.prompt: Set up Pipa, but I want to skip the profile questions and I do not want to connect tools right now.
evals.expected_output: Allows every core question and connector review to be declined while completing the profile with explicit skipped fields.
assertions: Does it allow all three core questions to be skipped?
Does it allow connector review to be declined without trapping the user?
Does it mark setup complete and summarize skipped or unknown state honestly?

evals.prompt: Set up Pipa and use https://example.com to help draft my business profile.
evals.expected_output: Offers a read-only best-effort website read and uses only confirmed supported public facts while still asking the core questions.
assertions: Does it treat website assistance as optional and read-only?
Does it confirm supported facts before saving optional website context without overwriting user content?
Does it avoid enrichment services, email reverse lookup, or invented positioning?

evals.prompt: Finish setting up Pipa and create a daily brief automation while you are there.
evals.expected_output: Completes setup without creating automation and keeps recurring behavior outside the setup operation.
assertions: Does it avoid creating tasks, reminders, automations, triggers, or recurring workflows during setup?
Does it keep the requested automation as a separate management objective?
Does it avoid inventing a scheduled setup route?

evals.prompt: Not now. Skip Pipa setup and help me with my actual work instead.
evals.expected_output: Accepts the decline, leaves profile and connectors untouched, and continues with concrete work.
assertions: Does it avoid connector or memory actions after setup is declined?
Does it avoid creating or changing `~/.pipa/profile.md`?
Does it continue with concrete work without another setup question?
